datum: Project-owner-selected datum, 2026-11-10: origin at the bottom-left corner of the board's bounding rectangle in the rear (component-side) view with USB at the top, i.e. the battery-connector end of the bottom edge. X runs right, Y runs up toward USB, Z toward the viewer: the rear surface is Z=0 and the substrate extends to Z=-T. Measure X from the left-most board edge and Y from the bottom-most board edge in that view; the origin is the bounding-rectangle corner and may lie off the physical board. The front view (photo 3081) sees this corner at its bottom-right; the motor-lead end of the bottom edge is the far end, near X=W.
